lead.event: OJK and IDX roll out capital market reform measures
lead.headline: OJK and IDX roll out reforms, expand HSC committee to nine
lead.blurb: Trading oversight shifts from unusual market activity notices and suspensions toward investigations of transactions and securities accounts, with restrictions or temporary halts for specific accounts. The nine-member High Shareholding Concentration committee will comprise four self-regulatory organization representatives and five external members. From 2 November, HSC-listed stocks are planned to be excluded from the IHSG, a change that could prompt portfolio adjustments.

deals_control.event: Puncak Jaya Sejahtera takes control of Andira Agro
deals_control.headline: Puncak Jaya Sejahtera takes control of ANDI with a 33% stake
deals_control.blurb: Andira Agro said Puncak Jaya Sejahtera bought 3.08 billion shares at Rp30 each for Rp92.56 billion. The shares came from Anugerah Perkasa Semesta and Central Energi Pratama.

earnings_guidance.event: Ancora Indonesia Resources reports nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: OKAS reports USD2.45 million profit for nine months
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ancora’s sales were USD121.48 million, nearly unchanged from USD121.58 million a year earlier, while gross profit fell to USD30.92 million from USD34.57 million. Operating profit rose to USD14.78 million from USD5.87 million as net other operating expenses declined to USD755,560 from USD14.51 million.

earnings_guidance.event: BNI reports nine-month 2026 earnings and loan growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BBNI reports Rp16.12 trillion nine-month profit as loans grow 22.2%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BNI’s pre-provision operating profit rose 11.6% to Rp27.5 trillion, while net interest margin fell 30 basis points to 3.5%. Mirae Asset Sekuritas analyst Muhammad Nurkholis Syafruddin maintained a neutral view and warned that credit costs may normalize from the low 0.7% cost of credit in Q3.

earnings_guidance.headline: UNTR reports 61% nine-month 2026 profit decline to Rp4.46 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: United Tractors' revenue fell 10% to Rp90.33 trillion, reflecting weaker heavy equipment and coal mining results and lower gold sales amid first-half licensing issues at Agincourt Resources. The Martabe mine resumed operations in the second half. The company booked Rp3.5 trillion in non-recurring items, mainly geothermal impairment and payments related to the Stargate nickel mine's forest-use approval.

earnings_guidance.headline: MAPI reports 25.1% nine-month net profit growth to Rp2.1 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Nine-month net revenue rose 24.5% to Rp37.4 trillion, while third-quarter net profit climbed 22% to Rp676 billion on revenue up 26.7% to Rp13.3 trillion. Retail generated Rp32.45 trillion, or 86.7%, of nine-month revenue, and all segments grew year on year. Management said it would prepare all business lines for fourth-quarter year-end celebrations.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: IDX revises index constituents and removes HSC stocks from IHSG
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX removes 81 HSC stocks from IHSG, revises LQ45, IDX30 and IDX80
market_structure_policy.blurb: The October evaluation adds Semen Indonesia to LQ45, Indosat and Bukit Asam to IDX30, and Astra Agro Lestari, Timah and Tjiwi Kimia to IDX80; each index also has exits. Changes take effect 2 November, with the evaluation period running until 29 January 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS begins its Rp500 billion share buyback program
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS begins Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia is using internal cash, with repurchases capped at 20% of paid-up capital and scheduled through 26 January 2027. Its pro forma capital adequacy ratio is projected to fall from 20.41% to 20.19%, though the bank said the buyback would not materially affect its capital position or operations.
